fusions.name: Snared Supper
fusions.desc: Throws a snare that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Locked Pantry
fusions.desc: Drops bars around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their armour, and leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Fattening Pen
fusions.desc: Closes a pen 5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward, and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Kept for Later
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you heal for 20% of all damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
